issues: 纯 #000 平铺底，胶囊悬在虚空里，没有光源、地面与空间感
胶囊是一块平涂 #0d0d13，只有一圈 1px 内描边，读不出玻璃的厚度与受光上沿
DesignStage 走 transform 放大 4 倍，字形与 1.5px 描边是合成期放大的位图
1.25→1 的落位只有缩放，没有"从镜头前落回去"的景深变化；声波图标 1.5px 半透明白框偏粗
changes: 背景换成带冷色相的近黑渐变 + 顶部柔和主光 + 暗角 0.55 + 软光颗粒；胶囊下方加一抹强调色地面反光，与内嵌光同挂 g 一起熄灭
胶囊加上亮下暗的体积渐变、两端渐隐的顶沿高光线、底缘内暗边与两层落地影（随缩放收紧），收尾落成有厚度的中性深色玻璃条
改用 DesignStage raster="zoom" 按 1080p 原生栅格化，文字与细线锐利
落位前 0.16 段叠 0.75 设计 px（≈3px）的失焦模糊，随落位收焦；声波方块改 1px 发丝描边 + 微渐变 + 内高光，光标掺强调色随 g 回中性
时间轴、缩放 1.25→1、匀速打字窗口、g 的三层阴影收敛与定宽规则全部保持原值
issuesEn: A flat #000 background leaves the pill floating in a void with no light source, ground or depth
The pill is a flat #0d0d13 fill with one 1px inner stroke, so it reads neither as thick glass nor as lit from above
DesignStage upscaled 4x via transform, so glyphs and the 1.5px stroke were bitmap-scaled at composite time
The 1.25→1 settle is scale only, with no sense of dropping back from the lens; the 1.5px translucent icon frame is heavy
changesEn: Background is a cool-tinted near-black gradient with a soft top key light, 0.55 vignette and soft-light grain; an accent floor bounce under the pill fades on the same g as the inner glow

The pill gains a top-lit volume gradient, an edge-faded specular top line, a dark inner bottom rim and a two-layer contact/ambient shadow that tightens with the scale, ending as a neutral dark glass bar with thickness
Switched to DesignStage raster="zoom" so text and hairlines rasterize natively at 1080p

The first 0.16 of the settle carries a 0.75 design-px (~3px) defocus that racks into focus; the wave icon gets a 1px hairline, subtle gradient and inner highlight, and the caret carries a hint of accent that neutralizes with g
Timeline, 1.25→1 scale, linear typing window, the three g-driven shadow layers and the fixed-width rule are all unchanged
